notes: Single source version audited: H.R. 5125 Introduced in House (IH), 2707 chars, read in full. No referencedSources registered. All statutory cites (sec. 434 / 1-204.34, 431(b) / 1-204.31(b), 433(a) / 1-204.33(a), 433(b) / 1-204.33(b), 11-1528(a)(2)(C)) and quoted strike/insert strings match the source verbatim. The analysis correctly distinguishes the source's two spellings of the body: 'Judicial Nominating Commission' at section 431(b) vs 'Judicial Nomination Commission' at section 433(a)/(b) and in the title. No figure, direction/polarity, entity, or attribution errors found — every effect claim (transfer of authority Commission -> President, removal of the Commission-list requirement, prospective-only effective date) matches the source. Three minor UNSUPPORTED items are glosses on content not present in the bill text: 'Commission-service credit' / 'Commission-service reference' characterize the struck paragraph (4)/(5) of D.C. Code sec. 1-204.33(b) (only the strike, not the prior text, is in the bill), and 'moved to the Senate' is an unverified forward stage claim in likelihoodReason. One minor omission: the grammatical 'and' added at paragraph (3). gaps[] were reviewed and are all accurate absence statements. featured_quotes[]/criticisms[] (CR floor statements from Garcia, Norton, Sessions) are OUT OF SCOPE for this audit — the bill-text source is the IH version and contains no Congressional Record, and no CR referencedSource is registered, so they could be neither verified nor refuted; not flagged. The cache title/official_title carry an 'of 2025' suffix that the Act's own short title (SEC. 1) omits — metadata only, not audited here.
